g.title: Trigger: Repeated validated outcomes suggest a behavior or workflow lesson. Preconditions: Evidence links resolve.; Project and privacy scope are known.; Replay case is reproducible. Controls: case_id; baseline_version; candidate_version; lesson_id; scope Outputs: Versioned lesson with evidence references and explicit scope. Failures: Insufficient recurrence keeps lesson as candidate.; Privacy review rejects global promotion.; Regression retires the lesson.; Missing evidence prevents retrieval. Signals: Evaluation result.; Human decision.; Lesson version.; Scope and evidence references.; Later recurrence rate.

ID: read_model Responsibility: Serve current lineage, stack, review, and exact-head freshness queries. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: PostgreSQL read projection State variables: head_sha; review_status; projection_revision Invariants: A projection never authorizes a head different from its assessed head. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/architecture-diagrams.md:1#Tabellio System Architecture Diagrams @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: context_broker Responsibility: Return bounded project-specific evidence and lessons to a review or agent run. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Read-only Node.js API or MCP tool State variables: request_scope; head_sha; packet_digest; access_decision Invariants: Context is scoped to the requester, project, repository, and exact head. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/architecture-diagrams.md:1#Tabellio System Architecture Diagrams @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: evaluation_worker Responsibility: Replay cases, compare behavior, and create scoped candidate lessons. Owner: Tabellio maintainers and evaluation owner Runtime: Node.js worker and evaluation harness State variables: case_id; baseline_version; candidate_version; outcome Invariants: Lessons require evidence references and versioned outcomes. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/external_document: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agent-evals @ current-2026-08-30

ID: lesson_store Responsibility: Store versioned project, organization, and general lessons with evidence links. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: PostgreSQL projection State variables: lesson_id; scope; status; version; evidence_refs Invariants: Candidate lessons do not silently change global behavior. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/external_document: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agent-evals @ current-2026-08-30

ID: human_approver Responsibility: Own accepted risk, privacy decisions, and promotion approval. Owner: Assigned human owner Runtime: Review interface State variables: decision; approver; decision_time Invariants: The system never fabricates human approval. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

text.tspan: 1. Select replay cases and outcomes / read-only query API
2. Request promotion decision / review UI or approval API
3. Store candidate or approved lesson / PostgreSQL transaction
4. Read scoped lessons / read-only query API
